ios.desc:
Never miss an important moment again.

Calendar notifications are easy to swipe away and forget. Beacon turns the events that matter into real iOS alarms: full-screen, loud, and impossible to miss, even on Silent mode or Do Not Disturb.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Connect your calendars. Beacon works instantly with the iOS Calendar app. If it's on your iPhone, Beacon can see it. No new accounts, no login required.

2. Create smart rules. Set conditions like "meetings my manager has accepted" or "any weekday event starting before 9 AM". Beacon watches your calendar, matches upcoming events, and creates alarms for them automatically.

3. Alarms set themselves. Built on Apple's AlarmKit, Beacon schedules true system alarms, with a Live Activity countdown on your Lock Screen when you snooze.

4. Stay in control. Add or remove an alarm for any single event with a couple taps, and see every event and alarm together on a clean daily agenda.

WHY BEACON?

Notifications get missed. Alarms don't.

Beacon turns your calendar into real alarms - the kind that break through Silent mode and Do Not Disturb. Your 8 AM client call, your partner's birthday dinner, a rotating night shift, a flight you can't miss.

Built for shift workers, healthcare staff, frequent flyers, and anyone whose schedule doesn't fit a normal day.

KEY FEATURES

• Real alarms, not notifications. They ring on Silent and Do Not Disturb
• Filter by who is invited and how they replied, down to a single person
• Ring only once enough people have accepted, or only when nobody has
• Filter by time of day and day of the week
• Works with every calendar already on your iPhone
• Live Activity countdown when you snooze an alarm
• Today view: your events and alarms on one clear timeline
• Privacy-first: your events never leave your device
• Accessible by design: readable text, light and dark mode, color-blind friendly colors
• Available in English and Japanese

BEACON PREMIUM

Beacon is free to download and includes one active rule, so you can build a real rule with the full condition set, filter by event name, description, calendar, time of day, day of the week, and exactly who is invited, and have it running before you decide anything.

Beacon Premium lifts the limit. Keep as many rules running at once as your schedule needs: one for work hours, one for your partner's shared calendar, one for flights, all live at the same time.

quotes.text:
I kept missing appointments and meetings because calendar notifications are too easy to ignore. Alarms, on the other hand, always break through silent mode/DND and force you to acknowledge them — but setting them manually every day was another chore.

With iOS 26’s new AlarmKit, I built Beacon: it automatically syncs with your Apple Calendar and converts important events into real iOS alarms. You can define simple rules (like “only events with ‘Interview’ in the title” or “meetings with 3+ attendees”), and Beacon sets the alarms for you — no extra work required.

Would love feedback!
